visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown tabby cat wearing a grey hooded sweatshirt and black athletic pants with white stripes jumps over a low concrete wall on a rooftop. The background shows a clear blue sky and residential apartment buildings with balconies and air conditioning units. The lighting is bright and natural daylight. (2) The cat runs along a narrow ledge with a city street visible far below. It jumps across a significant gap between two concrete sections of the roof structure. The camera tracks the cat's movement from the side, emphasizing its athletic posture and the realistic texture of its fur and clothing. (3) The cat performs a front flip while jumping between structural beams on the rooftop. It lands precisely on a narrow edge. The surrounding urban landscape features high-rise commercial buildings in the distance. The cat's facial expressions are concentrated, and its paws are covered in black and white sneakers. (4) A close-up shot captures the cat running directly towards the camera on a rooftop walkway. It effortlessly vaults over several obstacles. Small birds are seen flying away in the background. The scene ends with the cat performing a dynamic leap towards another building, showcasing intense physical agility.

(2) A synthesized whoosh sound effect with a quick frequency sweep occurs, followed by two distinct heavy thuds with short spectral bandwidth. The BGM continues with a consistent beat strength and energy level. The ambient noise floor is extremely clean, suggesting a studio-mastered or post-produced track with minimal environmental noise. (3) Multiple rapid percussive impact sounds are heard in sequence, resembling footsteps on a hard surface. The electronic music maintains its melodic progression without harmonic tension. The acoustic dynamism is high due to the interplay between the steady musical rhythm and the sharp, irregular sound effects associated with the movement. (4) The music continues with an upbeat, energetic vibe. Another series of impact sound effects and air-displacement whooshes are layered over the track. The signal-to-noise ratio is excellent, with the primary audio components being the BGM and intentional post-production SFX. No speech or crowd noise is detected in the mix.
